test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

(A) The institute / (B) have been / (C) divided into / (D) multiple departments
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In part B of the given sentence, the phrase 'have been' is incorrect.
 
• The subject **'The institute'** is **singular**, so the verb should also be **singular**.
 
• The correct singular form of the verb is 'has been'.
 
• Therefore, the singular form of the verb 'has been' should replace 'have been' in **part B.**

Hence, the correct statement is "*The institute **has been** divided into multiple departments."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This error often occurs in sentences where the subject and verb must agree in number.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *The committee **has made** its decision.*
 
• *The students **have completed** their assignments.*
 
 
 
• It is important to ensure subject-verb agreement to maintain grammatical accuracy in sentences.
